expected_outcome.description: A report that explains the module's role correctly and cites it: it runs named jobs later, from an in-memory queue (`src/scheduler/queue.ts:8`; `schedule` at line 10), with a worker (`startWorker`, `src/scheduler/worker.ts:6`) that polls every second, runs due jobs through `handlers`, and retries a failed job up to three attempts with a growing delay (`MAX_ATTEMPTS`, line 4). It shows how the app uses it: `src/main.ts:4` starts the worker, and `src/jobs/email.ts:4` schedules a welcome job after 60 seconds. Saying the queue is memory-only, so scheduled jobs would not survive a restart, is a fair inference when marked as one.
